verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that a paperspace.com/pricing page exists. However, the quoted content covers only Gradient marketing and a free-account prompt, not per-GPU-hour rates for each GPU type. The '70% savings' claims and community mentions of a $9/mo Pro tier and an unspecified 'hourly rate' do not show a public per-GPU-hour price list, so the story is unevidenced.
